coverage_justification: Explicit static-stylized-v1 fixed eight views, zero turntable per batch dispatch
claim_scope: One armored fossil trunk specimen with leaf-base blocks and recessed reproductive sites among them. Keep these features volumetric and legible, rather than a generic cycad trunk or a Weichselia recolor. No invented leafy crown, complete parent organism or assertion that bennettitaleans are true cycads. Preserve the original limits on adult leaves.
dimension_status: Artistic nominal overall target; measured bounds recorded separately after build, not specimen measurement
recognition_features: Stout mineralized barrel trunk; no leafy crown
Three recessed reproductive sites amid armor
concept_decisions: Full circumferential trunk and leaf bases; reproductive recesses interpreted as simplified sites, no visible seed anatomy asserted. Broken top solid, not a hollow stump.
style: Original restrained palette-only refined low-poly; broad quiet planes and diagnostic relief
intended_use: Small supporting teaching prop, 256–512px diagnostic inspection
revision_reason: Resolve flat cap across reproductive cups and broaden leaf-base planes; irregular broken top.
